name: com.sipv.assetloader
description: Reusable, performant, extensible runtime asset loading library for Unity. RAM/disk caching, request dedup, pluggable sources/decoders/processors/policies.

samples.description: Interactive OnGUI scene proving cache tiers, dedup, custom runtime input, and all 3 Open/Closed extensibility points (custom decoder, processor, policy) live against the real pipeline. No setup needed.
